settings.label: Show variant pickers when there is no Kaching bundle
settings.info: With a Kaching bundle block every item gets its own Color / Size pickers inside the selected pack.

settings.label: Variant picker style
settings.info: Look of the Color / Size choices. The templates 'Variant tiles (Walmart)' and 'Size buttons (Shapermint)' set this for you.

settings.label: Show "Find my size"
settings.info: Appears only when the product has a size it can recognise: bra (34B, Band + Cup), pants W29 / L28, or letter sizes XS-5XL (with Petite / Regular / Tall inseam).

settings.label: Preferred size option name
settings.info: Used first when a product has several letter-size options. Other names (Sizes, Waist, Length, Inseam, Band, Cup...) are recognised automatically.

settings.label: Band question
settings.default: What is your closest Band Size?

settings.label: Cup question
settings.default: What is your closest Cup Size?

settings.label: Band sizes
settings.info: Comma separated.

settings.label: Cup sizes
settings.default: A, B, C, D, DD/E, DDD/F, G, H/I
settings.info: Comma separated, same order as the columns of the chart.

30: S, S, S, S, M, M, L, L

settings.label: Letter size chart (size: bust, waist, hips)
settings.info: Maximum body measurement in inches for each size, US standard. One size per line, e.g. M: 37, 30, 40.

settings.label: SAVE style
settings.info: What {save} prints in a pack subtitle. Compare-at styles = compare-at price minus pack price ($ or % of the compare-at price). % and amount come from the live Adlux discount the pack gets (Theme settings > Discounts picks which types count); hidden when the pack gets none.

settings.label: Accent colour (border, radio, badge, heading)
settings.info: Empty = the theme primary colour.

settings.label: Price colour
settings.info: Empty = accent colour.

settings.info: Total items = Buy + Get (e.g. Buy 3, get 2 FREE = 5; Buy 5, get 5 FREE = 10).

settings.label: Subtitle
settings.info: {each} = price per item, {total} = pack price, {save} = the saving in the SAVE style above ("SAVE {save}" is highlighted and hidden when nothing is saved), {qty} = quantity (prices from your Adlux discount).
